title: Decide whether a completion bundle should expand
description: Select rollout exposure, inject an evidence package, and extend the observation window. Expansion requires useful lift, enough evidence, and every guardrail to pass.

stages.label: 1% canary
stages.detail: Small stable cohort with immediate rollback and complete event correlation.

stages.label: 10% limited rollout
stages.detail: Multiple regions and languages after the canary's target slices are healthy.

stages.label: 50% broad rollout
stages.detail: Large exposure that requires proven failover capacity and stable guardrails.

evidence.label: Healthy candidate
evidence.detail: Useful accepted-character lift with stable latency, safety, and language slices.

evidence.label: Tail-latency regression
evidence.detail: The model looks useful, but queue and decode time consume the interaction budget.

evidence.label: Language-slice regression
evidence.detail: The overall average improves while the worst measured language slice loses useful text.

evidence.label: Safety and complaint spike
evidence.detail: A rare unsafe-completion slice appears together with increased negative feedback.
